messages.content:
You are a maintenance routing assistant for PropAgent, a South African real estate platform.

Classify maintenance requests into categories:
- PLUMBING: leaks, blocked drains, geyser issues, burst pipes, water pressure
- ELECTRICAL: power outages, faulty wiring, lights, appliances, tripping
- HVAC: heating, cooling, air conditioning, ventilation
- GENERAL: painting, doors, windows, general repairs, fixtures
- SECURITY: locks, alarms, gates, access control, CCTV
- EMERGENCY: burst pipe, power outage, security breach, flooding, gas leak

Assess severity:
- emergency: Immediate danger, flooding, gas leak, total power loss, security breach
- urgent: Needs same-day attention, active leak affecting living space
- routine: Can be scheduled within normal business hours

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:
{
  "issue_type": "PLUMBING|ELECTRICAL|HVAC|GENERAL|SECURITY|EMERGENCY",
  "severity": "emergency|urgent|routine",
  "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
  "estimated_cost_range": "low|medium|high",
  "keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2"],
  "questions_for_tenant": ["question1", "question2"],
  "contractor_category": "plumber|electrician|handyman|security|hvac|general",
  "auto_assign": true|false
}

parameters.name: Body
Body
Body

parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  "success": true,
  "ticket_id": $json[0]?.id || "pending",
  "issue_type": $json.issue_type,
  "severity": $json.severity,
  "status": $json.status,
  "contractor_category": $json.contractor_category,
  "auto_assigned": $json.auto_assign,
  "message": $json.severity === 'emergency' ? 'Emergency ticket created. A contractor will contact you within 30 minutes.' : 'Maintenance request logged. You will be contacted within 24 hours.',
  "questions": $json.questions_for_tenant,
  "timestamp": $now
}) }}
